system.description:
• Effect: Once per encounter, as part of an attack or your movement, enter a rage that lasts until the encounter ends.
  • While raging, gain a flat bonus to melee weapon damage: +2 (1st-9th level), +3 (10th-14th level), +4 (15th+).
  • The rage ends early at the end of your turn if you have neither attacked nor taken damage since your last turn ended, or when you fall unconscious.

activities.name: Rage
activities.text: Once per encounter, as part of an attack or your movement: enter a rage until the encounter ends, +{1:2, 10:3, 15:4} melee weapon damage. It ends early at the end of your turn if you have neither attacked nor taken damage since your last turn ended, or when you fall unconscious. Switch on the Rage toggle.
